title: A full physical modular-frequency identity turns Hardy positivity into nonlinear entropy comparison

statement.quantifiers: Every finite Hermitian weighted noise, faithful stationary sigma, arbitrary faithful full joint rho and finite untouched reference.
statement.assertion: J_B-kE_B=2sum_ordered q_i q_j c* K_(k/2)(beta-w,beta-v)c; K_(pi/2) PSD on every real finite node set, hence J>=piE.
assumptions: Full state eigenbasis, complex frequency amplitudes and all ordered pairs including diagonal.
Legal Lyapunov drift and physical stationary-log potential, no static Petz differentiation.

inputs: Full physical noise, modular-frequency blocks and root-state spectrum.
outputs: An exact complete physical gap factorization with dimension-free pi bound.
interface.precision: Faithful finite inputs; singular extended-real closure is a separately audited limit.
costs: Arbitrary finite frequencies/spectra; no uniform numerical-conditioning or finite-bit runtime bound.
Sharp universal upper requires separate finite legal construction.

proof_mechanism: Compute physical drift and stationary-log potential in products B_w*B_v.
Reflect (i,j,w,v)->(j,i,-v,-w), preserving complex amplitude products and ordered factor two.
Use beta-shifted all-real kernel with exact hyperbolic coefficient.
Signed congruence t=tanh(x/2) converts to reproducing kernel [a(t)+a(u)-pi b(t)b(u)/2]/(1-tu).
Boundary multiplier identity gives positive hyponormal commutator; all finite Gram vectors allowed.
obstructions: Two-point positivity or a positive leftover potential is insufficient.
Zero, opposite and repeated nodes and stationary Hamiltonian must not be omitted.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Derive the complete physical gap before importing a scalar kernel; preserve reference, orientation and normalization.

review.source_reported: Source reports internally reconstructed and adversarially audited mathematics with scoped finite checks; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
